objective: Add the reviewed DR24 evidence-capture workflow definition to the default branch through PR #304 so GitHub can expose its manual workflow_dispatch trigger. This is a workflow-bootstrap change only; it does not acquire or validate astronomical data.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The DR24 evidence-capture workflow file was reviewed on the PR #302 branch. Its blob was previously verified byte-for-byte identical to the file added by PR #304.

Format Check and Lint passed. Cumulative Lifecycle Gate failed because the meaningful PR did not include a cycle record. Test Suite, Runtime Smoke Tests, Build and Dependency Audit were skipped as downstream jobs.
The lifecycle contract requires schema fields, supported metric names, NOT_MEASURED for unmeasured metrics, a valid regression status and an ACCEPT, REVISE or BLOCKED decision.

expected_improvement: Record the purpose, scope, evidence and unresolved validation state of PR #304 in the machine-readable cumulative lifecycle ledger.
Allow the Cumulative Lifecycle Gate to validate this record and proceed to downstream CI jobs.
Keep PR #302 and the scientific baseline unchanged.

correctness.before: PR #304 CI failed at the lifecycle-record requirement.
correctness.after: A schema-conformant lifecycle record is added to the PR #304 branch; the next CI run must verify acceptance.

reliability.before: Downstream test, smoke, build and audit jobs did not run because the lifecycle gate failed.
reliability.after: Those jobs can run only if the lifecycle gate passes; their results are pending.

scientific_validity.before: No source-backed DR24 evidence was generated by this bootstrap PR.
scientific_validity.after: No scientific-validity claim is made by this change.

measurement.trade_off: The record adds auditable process metadata. It does not change application code, source acquisition, data selection, identity resolution, feature extraction, model behavior or scientific acceptance criteria.

evidence: The existing lifecycle validator source was inspected on the PR #304 branch.

This new record has not yet been evaluated by GitHub Actions.

root_causes: The CI workflow requires every meaningful pull request to add a JSON record under configs/process/cycles/.
PR #304 changed the workflow file but did not include a cycle record.
unresolved: The new record must pass the repository lifecycle validator in CI.
The downstream test, smoke, build and dependency-audit jobs must run and their results must be inspected.

findings: A workflow bootstrap PR is still a meaningful repository change under the cumulative lifecycle policy.
A green Format Check and Lint do not establish that the lifecycle gate or downstream CI stages passed.
This record does not constitute source-backed DR24 evidence or scientific validation.
